title: Project list (laptop, written by a person)
description: %USERPROFILE%\.agentspace\projects.json (D54, D55): the projects that may have a host made, each with the date Terry approved it. Written by a person, read by the driver and the operator, and never added to by agentspace on its own. It governs only making a host: a project that has a host in hosts.json is placed whether it is listed or not. A missing file lists nothing. Strict like the contract's output schemas: anchored patterns end with $(?!\n). A file in which two entries share a name is not valid, though this schema cannot refuse it. See docs/state.md, "The project list".

version.description: The format's version. 0 until a change that an older reader would misread.

name.description: The normalized project name, in the lease contract's form.

approved.description: The date Terry approved the project, as YYYY-MM-DD.
